newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index edges in modest trading.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index edges in modest trading.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index rose marginally on Thursday in a moderate trading session, bourse officials and brokers said.
The index gained 12.61 points to close at 3401.92. Turnover was posted at 19.1 million shillings traded on 499,900 shares from 18.9 million shillings 351,909 shares on Wednesday.
The excitement that the introduction of Tourism Promotion Services (TPS) generated in the market has waned. TPS is the trading name of Serena Lodges & Hotels.
A senior broker said despite the fact that there were good buying orders for Serena, there was no support for the share at the current trading level -- a shilling less was preferrable.
Power monopoly Kenya Power & Lighting gained 2.0 to 149 while Total Kenya gained 1.50 to 70.50.
On average, shares across the board were marginally higher.
Kenya Commercial Bank gained a shilling to close at 95 while Barclays Bank was unchanged at 112. National Bank of Kenya eased to 15.75 from 16 while Diamond Trust Bank Kenya closed at 43 from 44.25.

Kakuzi gained a shilling to close at 103 while Rea Vipingo closed at 9 from 8.80. Uchumi Supermarket edged up 75 cents to close at 40.75 while Kenya Airways was unchanged at 8.50. Nation Printers & Publishers was unchanged at 165.
"Today's (Thursday) trading was dull and slow. There were no incentives to trade at all," another broker said.
The East African Development Bank corporate bond traded four million shares at 100.65 percent from 100.45 percent.
